text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So yesterday, I had a real nasty dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The ground was sparkling, you know?
So I dug it up to see what it was, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's like a maze in there,
and I can't find the exit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Geez, my heart was pounding so hard I sat bolt upright.
Couldn't get back to sleep after that either, y'know?
